### Are You in the Belly of a Big Fish?
Author: Fred Alberti
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-may-2-2008-11574679.html
Passage: Jonah 1:17
Points:
- Choosing our own desires instead of God's leading can leave us feeling trapped and overwhelmed.
- God has an intentional calling for your life, even if the assignment seems unappealing or difficult.
- The Lord actively prepares and equips believers to carry out His specific plans.
- Even after running away, we can turn to God in prayer because He offers second chances.
- Finding restoration requires committing our daily steps and future direction back to the Lord.
